description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the post-tokenization ConsoleArguments parser/state cluster using the existing safe Rust conhost argument state machine and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: The existing safe Rust console_argument_parser reproduces Microsoft's width/height state, zero and -1 values, and rejects malformed or out-of-range dimensions.
The existing parser owns headless mode, duplicate idempotence, interaction with a legacy server handle, and the explicit-client boundary that keeps --headless inside the client command line.
The existing parser owns server/signal handle parsing and the Microsoft invalid and missing-value vectors without requiring a Win32 handle API.
The existing parser reproduces the supported pty feature, repeated supported values, unsupported tty values, missing values and switch-shaped invalid feature values.
